raw.query: WITH owner AS (SELECT run_id,is_current,superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE run_id IN ('measured:vllm_per_request','measured:vllm_h100_trace')), trace AS (SELECT img,count(*) AS requests FROM provenance.measured_request WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owner WHERE run_id='measured:vllm_per_request' AND is_current=true AND superseded_by IS NULL) GROUP BY img), model AS (SELECT CASE WHEN source_path LIKE '%silicon_burst3.json' THEN 'burst3' WHEN source_path LIKE '%silicon_burst5.json' THEN 'burst5' END AS window_name,n_images,mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine='aic' AND image_px=448 AND is_valid=true AND (source_path LIKE '%oneworker_artifact/silicon_burst3.json' OR source_path LIKE '%oneworker_artifact/silicon_burst5.json')), tower AS (SELECT n_images,mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine='vllm' AND image_px=448 AND is_valid=true AND source_path LIKE '%vllm_eager_dense.json'), bins AS (SELECT model.window_name,trace.img,trace.requests,model.mean_ms AS model_ms,tower.mean_ms AS vllm_ms,100.0*abs(model.mean_ms-tower.mean_ms)/tower.mean_ms AS abs_error_pct FROM trace JOIN model ON model.n_images=trace.img JOIN tower ON tower.n_images=trace.img), schema_check AS (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.attname ~* '(^|_)(image|img)_(px|size|width|height|resolution)($|_)') AS image_size_columns,count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.attname='is_current') AS is_current_columns,count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.attname='is_superseded') AS is_superseded_columns,count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.attname LIKE '%\_effective' ESCAPE '\') AS effective_columns FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='provenance' AND c.relname='measured_request' AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.measured_request WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM owner WHERE run_id='measured:vllm_per_request' AND is_current=true AND superseded_by IS NULL)) AS trace_requests,(SELECT image_size_columns FROM schema_check) AS trace_image_size_columns,(SELECT is_current_columns FROM schema_check) AS measured_is_current_columns,(SELECT is_superseded_columns FROM schema_check) AS measured_is_superseded_columns,(SELECT effective_columns FROM schema_check) AS measured_effective_columns,(SELECT count(*) FROM owner WHERE is_current=true AND superseded_by IS NULL) AS current_unsuperseded_owner_rows,(SELECT sum(requests) FROM trace) AS regime_requests,(SELECT count(*) FROM trace) AS regime_bins,(SELECT count(DISTINCT image_px) FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine='vllm' AND is_valid=true) AS available_vllm_image_sizes,(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(image_px,row_count ORDER BY image_px) FROM (SELECT image_px,count(*) AS row_count FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine='vllm' AND is_valid=true GROUP BY image_px) q) AS vllm_rows_by_image_px,(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(img,requests ORDER BY img) FROM trace) AS requests_by_image_count,(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(window_name,round(max_error::numeric,6) ORDER BY window_name) FROM (SELECT window_name,max(abs_error_pct) AS max_error FROM bins GROUP BY window_name) q) AS max_abs_error_pct_by_window,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('window',window_name,'img',img,'requests',requests,'model_ms',model_ms,'vllm_ms',vllm_ms,'abs_error_pct',round(abs_error_pct::numeric,6)) ORDER BY window_name,img) FROM bins) AS per_window_bin_breakdown
raw.observed: The current unsuperseded trace has 7817 requests, 0 image-size columns, and 8 image-count bins covering all 7817 requests; at fixed 448 pixels, the maximum absolute error versus vLLM is 10.907543% in both burst3 and burst5.
raw.claimed: Uniform 448^2 assumption used; cost model matches vLLM vision tower within 12.8% across the serving regime.
raw.evidence: Trace dimensions are unrecorded, and every represented image-count bin passes the 12.8% bound under the stated fixed-448 comparison.
